en: A black-and-white vintage view of a small railway station complex on a hillside. In the foreground there are large stacks of cut wood and several barrels. Behind them stand low station buildings and a slightly larger two‑story station house with a sign on the facade. A horse and cart are visible near the buildings. Modest houses sit on the hill in the background. The title text at the top reads "MÖLNDAL. JÄRNVÄGSSTATIONEN."
